content: Maya borogiko e ŋgamoiye tɨne, Jona i naŋgo weya Giya Loi le Loi.

content.text: “Mbaŋa inaŋgu vuyowo laghɨye e tɨne,
na ya una Giya Loi idan,
kaero u thalavuŋgo.
Bode moli ramaremare e ghambanji,
ya una idan thalavu kaiwae,
na u loŋwa ghalɨŋaŋgu.
U duutuŋgo e ŋambuwoko tɨne bode moli,
njighɨ i vaghɨliyaŋgo,
len bagodu laghɨlaghɨye thɨ bebe e vwataŋgu.
Lo renuwaŋa yaŋaeŋge kaero mendava u kitenɨyathuŋgo e ghen
ko tembene ya thuweva len Ŋgolo Boboma.
Mbwa i wovululuŋgo na i wovoŋguŋgo;
na njighɨ i garubu riwaŋguke laghɨye,
na njighɨko wolewaniye i ghavwa umbalɨŋgu.
Ya nja e ŋambuwokote e ououko rɨgherɨghenji
e valɨvaŋgake iya ghathɨnɨmbako
ma mbaŋa regha i mavu.
Ko iyemaeŋge ghen, wo Giya Loi, lo Loi,
u vaŋgunjoghaŋgo e yawayawaliŋgu
bode moli e ŋambuwoko tɨne.
Mbaŋa ya ghamɨno yawaliŋgu kaero ne iko,
amba ya renuwaŋakikiŋge na ya naŋgo e ghen, o Giya Loi
na e len Ŋgolo Bobomana e tɨne u loŋwa ghalɨŋaŋgu.
Thavala thɨ goru weya vatavatadɨŋgi
na ma e ghanji thovuye,
kaero thɨ roiteteŋge na
gharen ma i nja weŋgi.
Ko iyemaeŋge ne ya wothu taraweŋge;
ne ya vakatha vowo na i voro e ghen
na ya vakatha ŋgoreiya va lo dagerawe e ghen.
Vamoru i mena weya Giya Loi!”

content: Amba Giya Loi i vakatha borogima na i thegharaŋgiya Jona e njighɨko ghadidiye.
